objective: Win one paid WebAPI ambassador campaign worth up to USD 600 by building a tested ChartQuery guide around LazyingArt's real multilingual provenance graph.

source_need.title: WebAPI Group ambassador program
source_need.published_scope: Public tutorials, technical threads, articles, and videos that help developers understand one of WebAPI Group's API products.
source_need.published_compensation: Up to USD 600 per campaign, paid by bank transfer within 30 days after the live content is reviewed and validated.
source_need.submission_requirements: Send WebAPI Group a LinkedIn message with the applicant name, social profiles, one published sample, and the API the applicant wants to cover.
source_need.assistance_policy: The program rejects misleading claims, spam, and AI-generated content without real editing and personal input.
source_need.policy: Approval, an agreed campaign amount, published content, validation, payment processing, and received revenue are separate evidence states. Do not build speculative vendor content before approval and access terms are clear.

fit.proposed_content: A tested Python guide that turns a provenance graph from a multilingual book collection into reproducible SVG and PDF diagrams, with the exact inputs, generated artifacts, and failure notes.
supported_now: A public multilingual provenance graph and a local knowledge-collection workflow
A published technical API, CLI, and MCP workflow article
not_claimed: Existing ChartQuery use, a WebAPI relationship, approval, campaign validation, audience performance, payment, or revenue
A customer result or an untested API capability
fit.claim_boundary: The existing graph and writing sample prove relevant public work. The ChartQuery integration remains a proposal until the program approves it and a tested implementation exists.

application.method: One reviewed message through the Message action on WebAPI Group's official LinkedIn company page
application.delivery_evidence: The isolated project browser showed the Other topic, the complete 654-character message, and the enabled Send action. One click produced LinkedIn's 'Message sent successfully.' confirmation; no retry was made.
application.policy: Do not send another message before the review date. If accepted, confirm the exact campaign, amount, API access, deliverables, technical-validation method, rights, disclosure, payment details, and assistance expectations before producing vendor content.
